meta.name: Bigger-Turrets
meta.author: AlexandreMonoyioudis
meta.description:
Turret spam is boring. These turrets are bigger stronger but require more complex supply chains for the early game, 
+ chain cannon that requires constant ammon supply. 
+ heavy cannon that requires constant coolant.
 + shatter anti-air gun. 
 + swarm launcher that uses silicon and electrisity.
 + 2x2 solar panel
